crops.reading: Diagram DMSO cab end: identical to the 465 DMSO (cab door, oval/big/oval, door 1).

crops.feature: diagram: coupled ends: DTSOL toilet windows, DMSO
crops.reading: Diagram coupled ends: DTSOL (left) ends small, small (toilet), big, small; DMSO (right) starts small, big, big: the cars differ at the coupled end.
Diagram DTSOL outer end: a full cab like the DMSO's (yellow face, bumper, cab door).
Same face as the 465: yellow to an arch, two-pane screens, black band, lamp boxes, two bumper blocks; the number is at the LEFT of the band.

crops.feature: number on the black band, left
crops.reading: 466009 white-grey bold sans on the black band, left of centre.
Left box: pale upright rectangle outboard, round clear headlamp, red LED tail (lit) inboard.
Right box: red dotted tail inboard, round clear headlamp, small upright amber-cream rectangle outboard: mirrored.
crops.secondReader: second reader: red dotted at left, clear, small amber-cream rectangle right: agrees

crops.reading: Dusk: both tails lit red, each on the inboard side of its box.
White cab door with a tall window and mid bar, black front seal, white strip, yellow corner.
DMSO side: cab door, black band from 2.7 m, door 1, five windows, door 2, wordmark on the white strip between the doors, navy lower band.

crops.feature: DTSOL: its doors and the rear cab coupled to the 465
crops.reading: The DTSOL: two light blue double doors, navy lower band, and at its far end a yellow cab corner curving down, coupled to the 465.
crops.secondReader: second reader: orange/yellow strip at the left end curving down, two blue-grey door pairs: agrees (the DTSOL's cab end)

crops.feature: coupled ends of DMSO 64866 and the DTSOL
crops.reading: Coupled ends of DMSO 64866 and the DTSOL; both carry the wordmark between their doors.
'southeastern.': 'south' black/navy, 'eastern' and the full stop periwinkle blue.
crops.secondReader: second reader: 'south' black, 'eastern' periwinkle, blue full stop: agrees

crops.feature: dot fade at the cab end
crops.reading: Halftone dots on the navy, larger toward the back, shrinking and thinning toward the cab; the top edge slopes down toward the front.

crops.feature: cab corner and cab door, three-quarter
crops.reading: Cab corner three-quarter: yellow only on the rounded corner, white cab door behind it, dots below.
White cab door: a tall round-cornered window toward the leaf's front, black front seal, white strip behind the door before the band; door not contrasting.
Door 1: two light blue leaves, each a tall round-ended window from just under the cantrail line; the band either side; the leaves turn in toward the bottom.

crops.feature: windows between door 1 and the cab door, the band's front end
crops.reading: From door 1 forward: band with a narrow oval window, a big window with a hopper top, a narrow oval, then the band ends and a white strip (about a third of the cab door's width) before the cab door.

crops.feature: lower bodyside: navy band and dot fade at the cab end
crops.reading: Navy lower band breaking into halftone dots toward the cab, dots shrinking forward; the fade's top edge slopes down toward the front, ending under the cab door's rear edge.

crops.feature: cab corner and cab door, three-quarter
crops.reading: Cab corner three-quarter: the yellow wraps the rounded corner and runs back a little onto the side ahead of the white strip and the cab door; black band and lamp box at the corner.
Whole front: yellow to an arch with a white dome, two screens, black band with 466040 at the left, two lamp boxes (clear headlamp outboard in each), two bumper blocks, coupler between.
'southeastern.': 'south' black/navy, 'eastern.' pale periwinkle, on the white strip under the window band.
